layout.description: 350 grams of what? Fabric weight means grams per linear metre, across the full width. From 100 grams of shirting to 700 grams of coat cloth, typical for a worsted suit: 350 grams. Illustration, source: Woolmark, Introduction to Wovenwear.

hook_candidates.spoken: What is behind this label on the cloth?
Most people read this number wrong.
The answer is in the thread, not the label.
hook_candidates.on_screen: The answer is in the thread

hook_candidates.spoken: If you only read the label, you miss the cloth.
Put the cloth on the scale: 350 grams, but of what?
hook_candidates.visual: Stoffstreifen auf der Waage, die Anzeige zählt bis 350

beats.spoken: Many suit fabrics come with a weight, for example 350 grams. But 350 grams of what? And is that a lot or a little? Put the cloth on the scale.

data.source: Woolmark: Introduction to Wovenwear, p. 10 · accessed 02.11.2026

beats.spoken: Woolmark gives fabric weight in grams per linear metre. That means one metre of length, the way the cloth comes off the roll, across the full width. So not a square metre. How heavy that strip is therefore also depends on the width.

data.source: Woolmark: Introduction to Wovenwear, p. 10 · accessed 02.11.2026

beats.spoken: The same manual shows the range: from 100 grams for light ladies' shirting up to 700 grams for heavy coat cloth. For a men's worsted suit, 350 grams is typical. So a heavy coat cloth weighs twice as much.

data.source: Woolmark: Introduction to Wovenwear, p. 10 · accessed 02.11.2026

beats.spoken: According to Woolmark, fabric weights have fallen over the years, because central heating and air conditioning make rooms more comfortable. For cool, light merino fabrics, Woolmark names less than 250 grams. Wool growers have responded with finer wool for lighter fabrics.

data.source: Woolmark: Introduction to Wovenwear, p. 10 · accessed 02.11.2026

beats.spoken: Remember: the number on the swatch means grams per linear metre. For a worsted suit, 350 grams is typical. Next time you see a swatch, check whether the number is on it. Follow Suitwerk for menswear with an eye for detail.
